headline: NEW -- Ukraine drone raid shuts all four Moscow airports
dek: Ukrainian drone raid on Moscow on the afternoon of Oct 23 forced Rosaviatsiya to suspend civilian flights at all four Moscow airports (Sheremetyevo, Domodedovo, Vnukovo, Zhukovsky) from 2:05 pm local; air alert sounded at Sheremetyevo, passengers told to take shelter; FlightRadar24: 85 flights…
sources: Rosaviatsiya / Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin / Oryol Region Governor Andrey Klychkov, via Kyiv Independent, TASS, FlightRadar24, Exilenova+/ASTRA (OSINT), LIGA.net, Mezha, United24 Media
fault_line: Does striking Moscow's airports and defense electronics push Russia toward talks, or toward escalation?

sections.what_happened: Ukrainian drone raid on Moscow on the afternoon of Oct 23 forced Rosaviatsiya to suspend civilian flights at all four Moscow airports (Sheremetyevo, Domodedovo, Vnukovo, Zhukovsky) from 2:05 pm local; air alert sounded at Sheremetyevo, passengers told to take shelter; FlightRadar24: 85 flights cancelled and 229 delayed at Sheremetyevo; 17 drones shot down heading toward Moscow (Sobyanin). Separately, explosions and a missile strike hit an industrial site in Oryol's Sovetsky District (governor confirms); monitoring channels identify it as the Proton plant, a defense-linked semiconductor/LED/electronics maker whose parts feed Iskander-M, Pantsir-S1 and S-71 Kover systems.
sections.what_verified: Airport closure: Rosaviatsiya order, Sobyanin drone count, TASS (all-clear 5 pm), FlightRadar24 cancellation figures. Oryol strike: governor's statement confirms an industrial site hit; plant identity from Exilenova+, ASTRA, Supernova (OSINT); Proton's defense-linked product line reported by Mezha/Current Time channel.
sections.what_disputed: Photos of drone debris on Sheremetyevo tarmac are social-media-sourced, not independently verified (Kyiv Independent flags this). Missile type disputed: Exilenova+ says Flamingo; other channels claim Storm Shadow. Governor called the site 'civilian'; Ukraine has not commented. IQ-Quarter Moscow City evacuation alarm was false (TASS, citing emergency services).
sections.why_matters: While Putin tells TV he's ready to resume talks in November, the war lands on Moscow's doorstep again: four airports closed, passengers sheltering, a defense electronics plant burning 350 km south. Talk and strike in the same day.
sections.context: Background: NEW -- Ukraine drone raid shuts all four Moscow airports; missile strike hits Proton defense-electronics plant in Oryol (Oct 23)

totw_analysis: Our read: While Putin tells TV he's ready to resume talks in November, the war lands on Moscow's doorstep again: four airports closed, passengers sheltering, a defense electronics plant burning 350 km south. Talk and strike in the same day. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Does striking Moscow's airports and defense electronics push Russia toward talks, or toward escalation?
